metadata.note: ai-explainer / claude-hai. AI Debt Tracker WEEK 6. ILLUSTRATE LAW: the Claude UI appears at B00 (cold open, answered), B09 (verdict artifact), B10 (handoff) and B11 (outro) only — every body beat illustrates its concept as a native animated Remotion scene (REBUILD LAW). The four source PNGs and their SVG sources are REFERENCE in pantry/, never slotted as media. The script's five body sections become eight body beats: 0:45 splits into the reader's mechanism (B02) and its score (B03), with the non-determinism the script mentions in one clause given its own beat (B04); 1:20 splits into the three-way check (B05) and where the gap actually sits (B06); 1:55 becomes B07; and the closing on-camera section becomes a limits beat. FIVE THINGS NOT TO GET WRONG: removing the borrowed ledger removes last week's recall advantage — agent start is LEVEL with B0, not ahead; precision moves the OTHER way and both halves belong on the frame; 93.3% against B0's 92.8% is LEVEL, never 'better'; the reader's 89.7%/98.8% are graded on 43 reports, not the 94 it read; and the week's gate records DELEGATED, not cleared.
